The '''1998 [[Tippeligaen]]''' was the 54th completed season of top division [[association football|football]] in [[Norway]]. Each team played 26 games with 3 points given for wins and 1 for draws. Number thirteen and fourteen are relegated, number twelve has to play two qualification matches (home and away) against number three in the [[1. divisjon|first division]] (where number one and two are directly promoted) for the last spot.
